remarks: Rare offering in the city of Downey from long term owner. This well located 6 unit property features all 2 and 3 bedroom units. There are currently 2 vacant units, allowing an investor the ability to choose their own tenants and rent for market pricing. The available vacant units include a ground level updated 2Br + 2Ba unit and a 2nd floor fully remodeled 3Br + 1.5Ba unit with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, ceiling fans, and new flooring. The property offers convenient rear alley access and 5 on-site parking spaces, including 2 garages, 2 tandem spaces, and 1 handicap space.
